scope: Read-only inspection of existing local captures; no new device acquisition.

extraction.reason: Current local Python lacks construct, serial and hexdump; no repository/m1n1 venv or matching existing Nix dependency output was found in the bounded checks. No dependency installed.
extraction.method: Used an ephemeral original Python stdlib structural reader matching pinned adt.py ADTNodeStruct/ADTPropertyStruct: little-endian node counts, 32-byte property name, masked31-bit byte length and4-byte property padding. Parsed complete trees with depth<=32, <=65536 nodes and <=4096 properties/node; checked every span, rejected duplicate properties and required exact full input consumption.
extraction.privacy: Only allowlisted /chosen firmware-version/system-firmware-version and /arm-io soc-generation strings were emitted. Strings were ASCII-pattern checked. No raw ADT, firmware bytes, addresses, serial, ECID, unique device IDs or console lines copied.
extraction.limits: This is not execution of the pinned semantic ADT decoder and does not validate every property schema or physical region. Recorded version strings are source data, not instructions.
extraction.observed_relevant_property_presence: The four selected paths (/chosen, /arm-io, /arm-io/sgx, /arm-io/gfx-asc) have the two version strings, an iop-version property of4bytes, and RTKit private-VM region properties. No explicit RTKit version/GPU ABI string was found among the selected-path property names. iop-version was not interpreted as RTKit protocol or GPU firmware ABI.
extraction.metadata_scan: Sixteen selected metadata JSON files contained no iBoot-/mBoot-/RTKit- numeric version strings. Four selected console files contained the same iBoot and mBoot strings and no RTKit- numeric version string. This narrow scan is not an exhaustive semantic analysis of every log.

selector_trace.fact: VERSION_MAP explicitly maps iBoot-8422.141.2 to V13_5. ProxyUtils.version selects /chosen/firmware-version; sfr_version separately selects system-firmware-version. The captured mBoot string is absent from VERSION_MAP and maps to None. The reference itself cautions that multiple OS firmware versions can share an iBoot version.

Ver.set_version assigns V from u.version, converts soc-generation H13 to G13, and only applies the G14X special case for a different generation. Ver.MATRIX contains V13_5/G13; layout predicates index those selectors. Defaults also happen to be V13_5/G13 but are not the evidence for this selection.

With the captured-reference selection, V>=V13_3, V>=V13_5B4 and G<G14X predicates are true; V>=V14_7 is false. Version-dependent padding/fields are therefore selectable for a bounded offline V13_5/G13 parser/builder. The T8103 allocation geometry remains three16K levels with a40-bit mask; this is not loaded-image verification.

The source distinguishes boot metadata from GPU image identity: comments and exact image-header matching acknowledge an iBoot version can identify multiple firmware images. Its inspected image table contains T6030/T8122 entries, not T8103. No selected capture contains the actual GFX firmware image/header/UUID evidence needed to close that gap.

decision.changed: A concrete candidate reference profile is now grounded in eight already-captured ADTs: V13_5/G13. Stop treating reference profile selection as wholly unknown or choosing it solely from defaults. Do not use mBoot-20457.0.125.0.2 to infer a newer GPU ABI.
decision.next_source_slice: If root authorizes it, an original bounded V13_5/G13 initdata-envelope/region-layout parser and detached builder can target this one explicit profile, with field/offset provenance, synthetic literal vectors, strict span/address ownership checks and no firmware publication. Profile selection must be labelled BOOT_METADATA_INFERRED, with runtime admission false; no automatic nearest-version fallback.
decision.still_blocked: An actual firmware-facing initdata serializer/transport cannot be admitted solely from this boot-version map. Loaded T8103 image ABI identity, current exclusive GPU ownership, shared-memory/UAT ownership, coherency and firmware completion remain unproven. Actual RTKit management version11/12 is a separate wire negotiation and is not established by V13_5.
decision.additional_evidence_required: A future separately authorized bounded observation would need nonidentifying, source-grounded loaded T8103 GPU firmware identity/ABI evidence and actual RTKit replies. This report neither requests nor performs it; the explicit observer hold remains.
